## About
Affordable Billiard Service, Inc. is Atlanta's oldest and largest billiard service company. We move, re-felt, repair and store pool tables, and we also work on snooker and carom tables.
You don't need to know the details of your table before you call. We'll help you figure out what kind of slate it has, what size it is and whether it's a furniture or contemporary style. All you need to know is who to call.
Our reviews mention Ron and his crew by name, along with clear communication and careful work from the first quote to the last leveled seam.

## Services
- Pool table moving: We take your 1 or 3 piece slate table apart, load it into one of our box trucks, then reinstall it, level it, seal the seams with beeswax and put the felt back on with staples or glue, whichever your table needs.
- Re-felting: We remove the old felt from the bed and rails, check and correct the level, slate plane and seams, then install new felt. Every re-felt comes with a free box of chalk to match your felt color. We carry worsted and non-worsted felt for home and commercial tables.
- Cushion replacement: We remove the old gum rubber cushions, sand the old adhesive off the rails and install the new cushions. New rail cloth is required.
- Repair and slate crating: We also repair pool tables and crate slate. Call us for details.

## FAQ
Q: What if I don't know what kind of table I have?
A: That's fine. We'll help you figure out whether your table is 1 or 3 piece slate, whether it's 7', 8' or 9', and whether it's a furniture or contemporary style.

Q: Do you work on snooker and carom tables?
A: Yes. We service and move pool, snooker and carom tables.

Q: How far do you travel?
A: We work throughout the Atlanta area, all of Georgia and the Southeast.

Q: Do you offer a discount for law enforcement or military?
A: Yes. Law enforcement officers and active duty military get 15% off. Please mention it when you book.
